== High Command ==
=== High Comm. Waypoints ===
Give units multiple waypoints:<br>
* Switch to High command mode '''[Left Ctrl+Space]'''.<br>
* Select the unit with '''[LMB]'''.<br>
* Hold down '''[Left Ctrl]''' while setting waypoints.<br>
* Edit the waypoint properties. Click on it with '''[RMB]''' and change group's formation or combat style.


=== High Command ===
High command enables commanding squads in the same way that squad command works for subordinates. If you are allowed to take the role of a high commander, switch to High command using '''[Left Ctrl+Space]'''.<br>
Units are represented by NATO markers that vary according to group type and size.<br>
You can assign command either in 3D view or on a map. The map offers more possibilities.


=== Group Type Markers ===
In High Command, various unit types are indicated by an icon. The most common symbols are:<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_inf.png|24px]] – Infantry<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_armor.png|24px]] – Armor<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_motor_inf.png|24px]] – Motorized Infantry<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_mech_inf.png|24px]] – Mechanized Infantry<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_uav.png|24px]] – UAV<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_artillery.png|24px]] – Artillery<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_recon.png|24px]] – Recon<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_air.png|24px]] – Helicopters<br>
[[File:a3_fm_b_plane.png|24px]] – Airplanes<br>
Marks are further labeled by size:<br>
[[File:a3_fm_group_0.png|24px]] – Fireteam (2-4)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_group_1.png|24px]] – Section (> 4)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_group_2.png|24px]] – Squad (> 12)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_group_3.png|24px]] – Platoon (> 25)<br>
[[File:a3_fm_group_4.png|24px]] – Company (> 60)
